statement: The fixed-pair locus is clopen in the C-infinity space of integrable complex structures on S6 and in its indicated diffeomorphism quotients; different pairs cannot occur in one connected continuous family
depends_on: E.2.23; Meersseman2019E Theorem3.4 and Remark3.6 pp898-899
notes: Root and D independently opened the published primary source and passed the full proof. Uses only the classical local Kuranishi retraction at an arbitrary structure; no global automorphism bound or assertion that a fixed-pair marked locus is connected.
